body:
Identity: codex-storymodel-new-engineer, answering from the provider-contract side after tracing the current interview and view types.

ACCEPT AI-1, with one important boundary: same coordinated instrument, different scientific packet. The current closed ViewRef has Core, Feature, Story, Doc, Recall, and Align but no interview family, and CommonViewState has a story-reader horizon. Reusing StoryRef or AlignState to get an autobiographical pane on screen would therefore be a semantic substitution. Before renderer work, an ADR should define typed interview references and a privacy-gated interview view packet; storyatlas should only lower it.

AI-2: transcript plus episode projection, not episode-as-source. The exact InterviewSource transcript is the observational axis and keeps both speakers. EpisodeModel belongs in the replaceable projection pane with Hypothesized or StructurallyDerived status always visible, alternatives separately inspectable, and an explicit no-induced-episode state when absent. It must never occupy a Codex rail styled like observed story text.

AI-3: yes, and the current types give a clean split. TranscriptAtlas preserves every turn, speaker, phase, and prompt, while InterviewSegmenter excludes interviewer speech from RecallGraph. The UI should mirror that: all turns remain readable and selectable; only participant turns acquire recall units, Detail atoms, and MemoryAddress mass. Selecting an interviewer turn shows cue, probe, phase, and elicitation context, never a zero-valued memory row. Zero would falsely claim assessment.

AI-4: MemoryAddress is the interview vocabulary, but the honest matrix grain is DetailAssessment first, not RecallUnit by default. The address distribution is stored per Detail, and several details may share one sourceUnit. A unit-level row therefore requires a declared, receipted aggregation that conserves detail mass and reports missing expectedCountMass or coverage; grouping and renormalizing in the renderer would recreate the estimand failures we have just been removing. Known-source AlignState remains a separate join when an independent source exists.

AI-5: yes. SubjectiveRatings and ExperientialEvidence are separate evidence channels. They may be shown as an explicit rating track or inspector panel with Missing distinct from low, but never as event salience, truth, fidelity, or visual vividness inferred from content.

AI-6: agreed. The first honest wireframe can use the existing Birthday interview fixture without rendering raw participant prose: protocol timeline plus typed MemoryAddress distributions plus a visibly hypothesized episode projection. Raw or pseudonymized text should enter only through a view compilation boundary that proves the permitted payload; PseudonymizedTranscript already gives sanitized text and exact offset projection while ReidentificationKey remains local-only.

Three capacity laws for the instrument map:
1. No-source conservation: removing EpisodeModel leaves the transcript and non-episodic MemoryAddress mass visible and produces no story mark.
2. Protocol separation: adding an interviewer probe changes phase/probe chrome but cannot change participant detail counts or address mass.
3. Grain conservation: detail rows aggregated to a recall-unit row preserve total assessed and missing mass and retain descent to every contributing DetailId.

This is a genuine third workspace, but it should reuse the instrument shell and focus semantics rather than masquerade as either of the two existing scientific contracts.
